Only the unwarranted deferral is removed. Pairs with gdrive adapter 2.8.0 (M2 durable read-back). Closes 20260630-8d20ea22-mitmcadefer.
infrastructure.name: agent-index-core
infrastructure.description: The foundational collection: session bootstrap, member management, org configuration, capability authoring, update orchestration, and the canonical CLAUDE.md template. Required for every agent-index install.
infrastructure.author: agent-index

infrastructure.name: agent-index-marketplace
infrastructure.description: The marketplace integration collection: discover, download, and install marketplace collections; check for updates across all installed pieces; refresh the marketplace cache.
infrastructure.author: agent-index

binaries.name: permission-helper-go
binaries.description: Native binary that reviews and applies permission changes via a one-click localhost browser flow. Registered as the agent-index:// URL scheme handler so chat-side links route directly to it. gdrive build (embeds the Drive API). apply-updates installs the binary whose `backend` matches the org's remote_filesystem.backend, to the shared install_destination.
binaries.author: agent-index
binaries._signing_values: unsigned-bypass = intentionally unsigned while code-signing certs are pending (Windows SAC will block; testers use SAC Evaluation mode, SIGNING.md). Flip to 'trusted' ONLY with a signed+notarized build, and BUMP current_version at the same time so members re-pull the signed bytes (apply-updates no-ops on an unchanged version).

post_install.darwin: run the bundled macOS installer (installer/darwin/install.sh {binary}) which places the notarized Agent-Index Helper.app in ~/Applications and registers via lsregister; NEVER run --register on the bare darwin binary (macOS registers bundles, not loose executables — bug 20260626-8d20ea22)

binaries.post_install_note: post_install_command is the legacy windows/linux form retained for back-compat; consumers on core 3.19.0+ MUST honor the per-platform post_install object (darwin = .app installer). Assets are code-signed (C.1); the sha256 below pins SIGNED bytes.

binaries.name: permission-helper-go-onedrive
binaries.description: OneDrive/SharePoint build of the permission helper (embeds Microsoft Graph; shares the Go core with the gdrive build). Release B. apply-updates installs this binary ONLY when the org's remote_filesystem.backend is 'onedrive', to the shared install_destination — so the helper skill, invite-member, etc. reference the same path regardless of backend. Additive grants only; transferOwnership returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
